pages.text: Lapidary is a cooperative fantasy survival overhaul centered upon discovery, gem cutting, mana, and magical insight.$(br2)This guidebook records what you learn about the world and the strange forms of magic hidden within it.

pages.title: A First Curiosity
pages.text: Sea glass is one of the simplest unusual materials found in Lapidary. For now, this page also serves as proof that Patchouli can display items from the mod correctly.
